The effect provides a modern and elegant way to bring focus and interactivity to any page background, making it suitable for both dark and light themes. It’s lightweight, reusable, and ideal for hero sections, portfolios, or interactive landing pages where subtle motion enhances the user experience without overwhelming the content.

author: ruixen.ui
name: stack-feature-section
desc: This component is a React + Tailwind CSS hero section with a heading, subtext, and call-to-action buttons on the left, plus an animated multi-orbit icon display on the right.

author: ruixen.ui
name: step-card
desc: The Professional Step Card is a clean, enterprise-ready multi-step form component built strictly with shadcn UI components. It guides users through sequential steps—like Email → Password → 2FA—using subtle slide transitions that maintain a polished and professional look. Fully compatible with both light and dark themes, it includes Back/Next navigation and supports easy integration via an onComplete callback. Designed for real-world use, this component can be reused across login flows, onboarding processes, or any multi-step form without unnecessary animations or playful effects, ensuring a smooth and efficient user experience.

author: ruixen.ui
name: success-login-card
desc: The Card with Micro-Animations on Success is a polished and configurable login card built with shadcn UI components, designed to provide users with instant, professional feedback. Instead of plain static messages, this card delivers subtle success animations such as a checkmark drawing itself or a smooth background color shift, creating a sense of accomplishment without unnecessary clutter. Developers can pass in customizable props like fields, onChange, onSubmit, and even choose the animationType (checkmark, color-shift, or none) depending on the brand’s tone. By keeping the layout clean and minimal while offering meaningful micro-interactions, this component improves user trust and makes the authentication flow feel more modern and engaging, all while remaining versatile enough to adapt to different applications.

author: ruixen.ui
name: table-dialog
desc: This component is a feature-rich, interactive data table built entirely with Shadcn UI components. It includes a fixed header and footer, allowing the table body to scroll independently, which ensures that column labels and summary information remain visible at all times. Each row includes a checkbox for selection, with the ability to select multiple rows at once. Actions for each row are accessible through a dropdown menu, offering options like “Edit” and “Delete.” The Edit action opens a dialog where all fields of the selected row can be modified using input fields and select menus, keeping the table layout intact and avoiding inline edits that can disrupt the table’s appearance. This design makes the table both highly reusable and user-friendly, suitable for applications that require structured data management, quick updates, and a clean, consistent interface.

author: ruixen.ui
name: table-with-dialog
desc: This Advanced User Management Table component is a feature-rich and modern UI built entirely with Shadcn UI. It combines a fixed header for clarity, interactive row selection using checkboxes, and a status badge system that visually distinguishes between active, inactive, and suspended users. Each row comes with an actions menu, allowing quick operations like viewing details, editing, or deleting a user, and destructive actions are highlighted with white text on a red background for clear visibility. Additionally, a dialog opens on demand, providing a focused space to display or edit detailed user information without leaving the table. The design is clean, responsive, and highly practical for dashboards, CRMs, and admin panels, making it a versatile component for managing user data efficiently.

author: ruixen.ui
name: tag-cloud-select
desc: The Searchable Tag Cloud Select is a modern, interactive component designed for apps that need both data-rich visualization and intuitive multi-select functionality. Built entirely with shadcn UI, it displays options as a tag cloud, where each tag’s size reflects its popularity or frequency and its color highlights its category or importance. Users can search through tags quickly and select multiple options, which appear as removable chips for clarity and control. This component is perfect for use cases like filtering blog posts by popular tags, selecting skills on onboarding forms, choosing analytics categories, or browsing keyword trends in dashboards.

author: ruixen.ui
name: team-access-card
desc: The TeamAccessCard component is a sleek, interactive, and fully customizable team management interface built using Shadcn UI and Framer Motion. It allows users to view, invite, edit, and manage team members within a project or workspace. Each member is displayed with an avatar, name, email, and role selector (Admin, Editor, or Viewer), enhanced with smooth entry animations for a polished user experience. The component also features an Invite Member drawer, enabling quick onboarding of new collaborators by entering their email and selecting a role. Additionally, a delete option allows seamless member removal, making this card ideal for use in admin dashboards, SaaS platforms, or collaborative tools. Designed with accessibility, clean design, and reusability in mind, the TeamAccessCard provides a modern and intuitive way to manage team permissions and access levels.

author: ruixen.ui
name: text-reveal-faqs
desc: The FAQs component is designed to provide clear and organized answers to common questions about Ruixen UI. It features a bold heading, a brief introductory text, and a link to the support team for additional help. The layout is responsive, with extra guidance visible on larger screens, making it easy for users to quickly find relevant information and get assistance when needed.

author: ruixen.ui
name: three-dwall-calendar
desc: The 3D Wall Calendar component transforms a traditional month view into an immersive, interactive 3D wall of days. Each day is represented as a panel, arranged in a grid-like wall, where users can tilt, scroll, or drag to change the perspective. Events appear as floating markers on these panels and can be clicked to reveal details inside neatly styled popovers. Navigation controls allow switching between months, while an inline form lets users add events directly to specific dates. This design not only makes browsing a month visually engaging but also provides a futuristic feel to event management, blending functionality with a dynamic 3D user experience.

author: ruixen.ui
name: tilted-dock
desc: This 3D Tilted Dock with Depth Layers is a futuristic UI component that makes a simple dock feel alive and immersive. The dock sits on a slightly tilted glass-like stage, creating the illusion of depth. Each icon responds dynamically: when hovered, it floats closer with a smooth tilt, while inactive icons gently fade into the background. A subtle parallax effect makes the entire dock shift in response to mouse movement, giving it a cinematic and interactive feel. Designed with a morphic glass background, it adapts seamlessly to both dark and light themes, while labels appear elegantly without breaking the layout. This unique combination of tilt, depth, and parallax transforms the dock into a visually striking and engaging centerpiece for modern web interfaces.

author: ruixen.ui
name: time-picker
desc: This is a sleek, minimal black-and-white time picker with a floating label and clock icon. It features separate dropdowns for hours and minutes with step-5 intervals, providing fast and user-friendly selection in both light and dark themes.

author: ruixen.ui
name: time-with-icon
desc: This component is a dynamic time input designed for modern, intuitive forms. It features a left-aligned icon that visually represents the time of day: a sun for daytime hours, a moon for nighttime, and a clock as a default when no time is set. The icon updates automatically as the user selects a time, providing immediate visual feedback. Built with shadcn/ui’s Input and Label, it maintains clean spacing and alignment.

author: ruixen.ui
name: timeline-02
desc:
This component is a vertical timeline that highlights the key milestones in Ruixen’s journey.
It uses cards with clean typography to present dates, titles, and descriptions in a structured way.
The design is minimal, responsive, and animated, ensuring clarity and elegance without visual clutter.

author: ruixen.ui
name: toolbar-dock
desc: React menu component- a Vercel-style floating icon dock with a single tooltip rail that slides and clip-path reveals each label above the hovered button.

author: ruixen.ui
name: tour-popover
desc: This Tour Popover component delivers a professional, guided onboarding flow using shadcn/ui’s Popover, Button, Progress, and Separator components. Each step is presented inside a compact popover with a clear icon, title, and description, making the information easy to follow without overwhelming the user. A progress bar at the bottom visually tracks how far along the tour the user is, while navigation controls (Back, Next, Restart) provide a smooth and intuitive way to move through the steps. By using professional Lucide icons like Home, Settings, HelpCircle, and Keyboard, the tour feels polished and business-ready, making it ideal for SaaS dashboards, admin panels, or any app where structured onboarding and contextual guidance are important.

author: ruixen.ui
name: universal-date-picker
desc: The UniversalDatePicker is a powerful and flexible date selection component designed to cover a wide range of use cases in a single, unified interface. It combines the simplicity of single-date selection with the versatility of range selection, while also offering quick-access presets like “Last 7 days,” “Last Month,” or “This Year” for efficiency. To make navigation effortless, it includes a year-selection card for jumping across years quickly, and can easily be extended to support month selection. Built entirely with shadcn/ui and React DayPicker, it provides a modern, accessible, and user-friendly experience that adapts seamlessly to dashboards, analytics, booking systems, and any application where robust date handling is essential. The UniversalDatePicker delivers both convenience and clarity, ensuring users can select dates with confidence and precision.

author: ruixen.ui
name: voice-message-bubble
desc: The Voice Message Bubble component is a sleek, chat-style audio player designed for messaging apps. It features a compact bubble layout with a play/pause button using lucide-react icons, a minimalist black-and-white waveform visualization, and a real-time progress overlay. Users can click on the waveform to seek through the audio, and the component accepts configurable props for bubble color, waveform color, audio source, and duration. Designed with Shadcn UI principles, it ensures a clean, modern, and theme-aware interface that integrates seamlessly into both light and dark layouts. This makes it ideal for voice notes, notifications, or short audio messages in any chat or social application.

author: ruixen.ui
name: wave-background
desc: The WaveBackground component is a dynamic WebGL-powered background built using the OGL library. It generates smooth, flowing wave patterns that are ideal for enhancing Hero sections or full-screen layouts without distracting from the main content. The shader logic creates layered sine and cosine waves that move over time, giving the appearance of continuous motion similar to ocean waves or liquid flow. The component supports both dark and light themes, automatically adjusting its color palette to blend seamlessly with different UI designs. It is fully responsive, scales to the parent container, and leverages GPU rendering for high performance, making it a modern, visually appealing background solution for landing pages, dashboards, or product showcases.

author: ruixen.ui
name: wheel-pagination
desc: This Wheel Pagination component provides a modern, interactive way to navigate through multiple pages. Unlike traditional numeric pagination, it shows a range of page numbers at once, highlighting the active page with scale and color, making it immediately recognizable. Users can scroll over the pagination area with the mouse wheel to move between pages, while previous/next arrows offer an alternative click-based navigation. The component intelligently keeps the active page centered within the visible range and supports a customizable number of visible pages, ensuring usability even with dozens or hundreds of pages. Fully compatible with light and dark themes, it also includes an onChange callback, allowing parent components to track the active page, making it ideal for dashboards, data-heavy applications, and modern UI interfaces that require a tactile, visually engaging pagination experience.

author: ruixen.ui
name: worm-loader
desc: The WormLoader is a vibrant and playful loading animation that uses colorful, gradient-filled worm-like paths gliding smoothly along a curved SVG track. Its dynamic dual-worm motion—powered by SVG stroke-dasharray animations—creates a visually captivating, continuous loop that feels lively and modern. With its responsive sizing, gradient transitions, and dark/light mode adaptability, the WormLoader is perfect for splash screens, progress indicators, or fun loading states where you want to add energy and personality to your UI without compromising on performance or style.

author: serafimcloud
name: tooltip-icon-button
desc:
A versatile button component with integrated tooltip functionality, perfect for providing contextual information on hover. Built with shadcn/ui and Radix UI primitives.

Features:
• Built-in tooltip for contextual information
• Adjustable tooltip positioning
• Built-in accessibility
• Multiple button style options
• Full TypeScript support
• Simple icon library integration

Props:
TooltipIconButton
• tooltip: string - Tooltip display text
• side?: "top" | "bottom" | "left" | "right" - Tooltip position (defaults to "bottom")
• className?: string - Custom CSS classes
• children: ReactNode - Button content, typically an icon

Use Cases:
• Icon buttons with explanatory tooltips
• Icon-based navigation menus
• Hover-activated help information
• Improved interface accessibility
• Clean UI with hidden contextual details

author: cnippet-dev
name: cnippet-collapsible

author: cnippet-dev
name: cnippet-empty

Dependency-free (just cva + cn).

author: cnippet-dev
name: cnippet-switch
desc: An accessible toggle switch built on Base UI's Switch primitive. Animated thumb with a springy press/scale interaction, two sizes (default and sm), controlled or uncontrolled usage via checked / defaultChecked, disabled state, and easy accent recoloring through the data-checked:* utilities. Re-exports SwitchPrimitive for advanced composition.

author: cnippet-dev
name: cnippet-toggle
desc: A two-state toggle button built on Base UI's Toggle primitive. Ships default and outline variants, three sizes (sm, default, lg), controlled or uncontrolled pressed state via pressed / defaultPressed, disabled styling, and springy pressed feedback. Works as a single button or grouped into a formatting toolbar. Re-exports TogglePrimitive for advanced composition.

author: cnippet-dev
name: cnippet-toggle-group

Supports single or multiple selection, horizontal and vertical orientation, default and outline variants with three sizes, and an optional ToggleGroupSeparator between items. author: kedhareswer
name: dither-sweep-navbar
desc: Pixel dither hover navbar for editorial sites: cells fill with a chunky left-to-right pixel dissolve on hover, with hairline-ruled cells, monospace caps, a wordmark that retracts on scroll and hover dropdowns. Self-contained: no CSS file, no images, no animation library.

author: kedhareswer
name: engraved-ticket
desc: Interactive event ticket card that breathes: hold it to breathe in, let go to breathe out, tap to re-spray the ink, hover to tilt. Two generated prints, paper engraving and crimson ornament plate, both recolourable. Use for event, invite or pass pages. No fonts, images or dependencies.

author: kedhareswer
name: etched-accretion
desc: Black hole shader background in WebGL: an engraved accretion disc in crimson and silver line work, light jets and etched contour nebulae drift with the pointer and flare when held. Five presets, grain and band controls. Use as a hero or section background. No dependencies.

author: kedhareswer
name: festivity-hero
desc: 3D sphere physics hero section: interactive spheres with dynamic collisions, mouse interaction and breathing motion, opened by a loading animation sequence and a responsive particle system. Use for modern landing page and product launch heroes.

author: kedhareswer
name: flashlight-text-reveal
desc: Flashlight cursor text reveal background in WebGL: hidden text is written on a dark, grainy wall and your cursor is the torch that reveals it; the light roams on its own when idle. Use as a hero or page backdrop. Plain WebGL1, React only.

author: kedhareswer
name: focus-pull-carousel
desc: Focus blur image carousel for React: a camera-style focus pull where the centred photo is sharp while its neighbours blur, shrink and fade continuously as you scroll, swipe or drag. Native scroll snapping, keyboard, buttons and autoplay, theme-aware, reduced-motion aware. Use for galleries, portfolios and product photos.

author: kedhareswer
name: foundation-primitives
desc: Raymarched 3D shapes WebGL card: soft frosted-gel primitives (asterisk, sphere, half-domes, hourglass and orb) under a magnifying glass lens. Tilts to the pointer; shapes lift, spin and select. Use as a hero accent or design-system showcase. Raw WebGL2, React only.

author: kedhareswer
name: frosted-hover
desc: Frosted glass hover ripple effect: hover a grid of hotspots over a hero image and frosted-glass ripples shimmer through a full SVG displacement filter stack. Use for immersive navigation showcases, portfolio covers or hero sections.

author: kedhareswer
name: glass-cards
desc: Glassmorphism hover stack cards: neumorphic and frosted-glass cards layered in a stack, with smooth GSAP animations and interactive hover effects. Use for feature highlights, pricing tiers or product showcases on modern landing pages.

author: kedhareswer
name: glass-clock
desc: Glassmorphism analog wall clock: a Braun-inspired glass clock UI with real-time Berlin timezone hands and dynamic glass reflections, plus an optional Tweakpane control panel for tuning shadows, colors and motion. Use as a dashboard widget or skeuomorphic showcase.

author: kedhareswer
name: glass-headline-hero
desc: Refractive glass text hero section: the headline is thick WebGL glass, and a slow colour field flows behind it and bends through the letters with prism fringes while the light follows the pointer. The headline stays a real h1 for SEO and screen readers. WebGL2, React only.

author: kedhareswer
name: halftone-nebula
desc: Interactive pixel-art halftone space background: a crimson nebula, sparkle stars and a dotted planet in three parallax depths. The pointer lights the gas and a click hangs a new star. Use as a hero or section background. WebGL, zero dependencies, React only.

author: kedhareswer
name: holo-card
desc: Holographic foil trading card you tilt with the pointer: the shine follows the viewing angle, bands like a real diffraction grating and parallaxes so the art stays inside the card. Four finishes, a flip, keyboard support and no images required. Zero dependencies, raw WebGL2.

author: kedhareswer
name: hotel-showcase
desc: Hotel listing image gallery with GSAP: a luxury hotel collection with image galleries, smooth transitions and overlay details, plus hover effects, keyboard navigation and a responsive layout. Use for travel, hospitality or real estate showcases.

author: kedhareswer
name: hover-expand-gallery
desc: Hover expand image gallery accordion: a row of hairline-separated panels with vertical labels, where the hovered or tapped panel grows to reveal its image while the rest stay rail-width. Below 1024px it becomes a vertical accordion. For portfolios and case studies. Pure CSS, no animation library.

author: kedhareswer
name: index-list-carousel
desc: Index list image gallery for React: big numbered titles on one side, one photo on the other; hover or tap a title and its photo wipes in while the row opens to show its caption. Keyboard, autoplay, theme-aware, stacks on mobile. Use for portfolios, case studies and agency sites.

author: kedhareswer
name: ink-blot-carousel
desc: Ink blot reveal image carousel for React: the next photo spreads in like ink soaking into paper, a ragged blot blooming from where you tap until it fills the frame. SVG mask with a turbulence filter, no WebGL. Arrows, swipe, keyboard and autoplay, reduced-motion aware.

author: kedhareswer
name: ink-flow-carousel
desc: Fluid simulation image carousel: every slide is wet paint driven by a real GPU fluid sim. Hover to stir the picture like ink in water, click to drop the next slide where you clicked; buttons, keys and autoplay pour it in from the edge. WebGL2 shaders, React only.

author: kedhareswer
name: ink-orbit-features
desc: Animated features bento with live diagrams: team edits flowing through a hub into printing reports, an integrations hub syncing one tool at a time, and a scrubbable forecast chart. Light/dark, zero dependencies.

author: kedhareswer
name: ink-orbit-hero
desc: SaaS hero section with a 3D sculpture: a banded headline whose serif line cycles with a blur, CTAs, a drawn-faces proof row, a live workflow demo dialog and a draggable generative ink sculpture. Light/dark, zero dependencies.

author: kedhareswer
name: ink-orbit-pricing
desc: Pricing section with a monthly/yearly toggle: plan cards whose prices count to the discounted amount, a highlighted bracketed plan, yearly savings and plan selection. Light/dark, zero dependencies.

author: kedhareswer
name: ink-orbit-testimonials
desc: Testimonials section with logo marquee: snap-scrolling quote cards with star ratings, drawn greyscale portraits and an arrows-and-dots pager, over a scrolling row of customer names. Light/dark, zero dependencies.

author: kedhareswer
name: isoline-bloom
desc: Interactive contour lines shader background: neon WebGL2 isolines that bend around the pointer and pulse on click. Zero dependencies, five color presets, reduced-motion aware. Use as a hero or section background.

author: kedhareswer
name: isometric-lift-carousel
desc: 3D isometric image carousel for React: portrait photos stand on edge in a tilted row and the selected photo widens and lifts out on a spring. Dark stage, titles, a glass prev/next pill with dots, keyboard arrows and swipe, reduced-motion aware. Use as a photo gallery, portfolio strip or product showcase.

author: kedhareswer
name: keycap-orb
desc: Interactive 3D keyboard keycap sphere in raw WebGL2: a ball of mechanical keycaps with design-tool legends floating over an ember floor glow, mirrored in the floor. Drag to spin it with momentum, hover to lift a cap, click or type to sink one and send a ripple round the ball. No three.js, no images, React only.

author: kedhareswer
name: kiln-wordmark-footer
desc: Giant wordmark footer card with a procedural SVG alphabet: a two-line motto, back-to-top key, address, navigation and social columns, a huge lowercase brand name and a legal bar, over a bold disc-and-slab backdrop. Re-brand, re-word and recolour through props.

author: kedhareswer
name: lanyard-badge
desc: 3D lanyard badge card with rope physics: drag it and the strap pulls taut, flick to spin, tap or use the built-in button to flip to the back. Verlet rope on canvas plus a CSS 3D card whose faces take any content. For conference, portfolio or team pages. No dependencies.

author: kedhareswer
name: lens-zoom-carousel
desc: Zoom blur image carousel for React: a full-screen slider where the next photo lands out of a soft magnified blur with fading ghost copies, like a fast camera zoom pull; going back zooms out. Arrows, swipe, keyboard and autoplay, reduced-motion aware. Use as a hero slider or photo gallery.

author: kedhareswer
name: light-shader
desc: Mesh gradient shader background in WebGL: a dark two-colour (#101010, #3A3A3A) mesh drift with film grain and a cursor-reactive spotlight. A drop-in animated gradient and noise backdrop for hero sections, made with the 21st.dev Shader Builder. Zero dependencies.

author: kedhareswer
name: lilac-dusk-canopy
desc: Leaf shadow shader background at dusk: dappled light through a swaying tree, a coral sun pooling across a violet plaster wall under film grain. Move to push the leaves, click for a gust of wind. One WebGL fragment shader, no textures, React only.

author: kedhareswer
name: lunar-boarding-pass
desc: Interactive boarding pass ticket card with a front and back: a VIP pass with a halftone Moon and a paper boarding pass with a perforated stub you can tear off. Tilt, flip and personalise every field through props. Use it for event tickets, launch invites or a playful hero.

author: kedhareswer
name: lycoris-specimen
desc: Scroll-driven WebGL 3D landing page: a procedurally modelled red chrome spider lily anchors a type specimen, with one continuous camera move scrubbed across six pinned frames. Use as an editorial, product or portfolio landing hero. Zero dependencies, React only.

author: kedhareswer
name: magic-hour
desc: Scroll-scrubbed video hero: scroll owns the timeline and nothing autoplays. Progress maps to a target frame and a damped chase writes it to currentTime, with seeks serialized so fast flicks skim instead of queueing. For product reveals and cinematic landing pages. Needs an all-keyframe (GOP 1) MP4.

author: kedhareswer
name: mascot-portfolio-hero
desc: Cursor-following mascot portfolio hero: an SVG character in a beanie turns its head to track the pointer, blinks and grins on click, set in a perspective-grid poster with a bold stacked headline. No images or dependencies; every label and colour is a prop.

author: kedhareswer
name: mono-contrast-preloader
desc: Monochrome film 3D text preloader: a typography cube tumbles your word one letter per face over a WebGL-graded reel crushed to high-contrast mono, with film grain and CRT scanlines. Use as a looping loader or a page gate that lifts to reveal content. React only.

author: kedhareswer
name: morph-gallery
desc: WebGL image transition gallery: slides dissolve through noise instead of cross-fading, the incoming photo burning through the outgoing one in drifting shreds. Arrows, thumbnails, keyboard, swipe and autoplay, with a cross-fade fallback. Use as a hero or full-bleed background. Zero dependencies.

author: kedhareswer
name: mouse-trail
desc: Image cursor trail effect powered by GSAP: floating images spawn along the mouse path as you move, for playful motion graphics on portfolios, agency hero sections and creative landing pages. A quick way to make a static page feel interactive.

author: kedhareswer
name: neon-katakana-preloader
desc: Cyberpunk neon preloader: data rain condenses into a glowing katakana sign while the load counts up, then it flickers on like a neon tube. Any word, any palette; loop it as a splash screen or gate your page. React only.

author: kedhareswer
name: noise-dissolve-reveal
desc: Noise dissolve page transition in WebGL: a coloured veil over your content burns away along a fractal-noise threshold, holes spreading into ragged islands until the page is bare, with fibrous edges instead of a wipe or fade. Use as a page gate or looping showcase. React only.

author: kedhareswer
name: onyx-glyph-preloader
desc: Cinematic logo preloader in sandblasted black metal: glitter-flecked glyph tiles orbit and light up as the load climbs, then forge into one mark above your wordmark. Bring your own glyphs, mark and metal palette. React only.

author: kedhareswer
name: paper-curl-carousel
desc: Page curl image carousel in WebGL: drag, flick or click and each printed slide rolls over a lit cylinder, shows paper stock on its back and casts a shadow on the next. One shader pass, spring-driven, with hover peeks, autoplay and a caption rail. React only.

author: kedhareswer
name: particle-animation
desc: Gooey particle cursor text reveal: a custom cursor emits particles as you move, merged by a gooey SVG filter into a mask that reveals scaling animated text. Use for creative hero sections and portfolio intros.

author: kedhareswer
name: particle-dissolve-carousel
desc: WebGL particle dissolve image carousel for React: on every slide change the picture breaks into coloured grains that ride a drifting flow field and settle into the next image. At rest it sheds dust and the pointer drags a wake through it. Autoplay, keyboard and swipe, reduced-motion aware. Use as a hero slider or full-bleed gallery.

author: kedhareswer
name: polaroid-line-carousel
desc: Hanging polaroid image carousel for React: instant photos pegged to a sagging string that slide along it as you drag and swing on their pegs with your speed, then settle. Click, arrows, keyboard and autoplay, theme-aware, reduced-motion aware. Use for travel galleries, portfolios and about pages.

author: kedhareswer
name: prism-comet-preloader
desc: WebGL shader preloader with a percentage counter: one streak of amber flame morphs through five passes as the page loads, then ignites into a star-shaped portal and the camera pushes through onto your content. Pass real progress or let it simulate; the pointer stirs the light. React only, no assets.

author: kedhareswer
name: rgb-glitch-carousel
desc: RGB glitch image carousel for React: cuts between photos with a signal glitch, the picture tearing into bands as its red, green and blue channels slide apart before snapping to the next. Canvas 2D. Arrows, swipe, keyboard and autoplay, reduced-motion aware. Use for music, tech and gaming sites.

author: kedhareswer
name: scanline-bloom
desc: Risograph floral shader background in WebGL: procedurally painted lilies and roses rendered as riso/CRT scanlines, stipple dither and paper grain. Use as a hero or section background for editorial and print-inspired sites. Zero dependencies, nothing downloaded.

author: kedhareswer
name: shutter-blinds-carousel
desc: Shutter blinds image carousel for React: a full-screen slider where the next photo swings in on horizontal slats, like window blinds tilting open one after another, while the old photo dims. Arrows, swipe, keyboard and autoplay, reduced-motion aware. Use as a hero slider or photo gallery.

author: kedhareswer
name: shutter-glyph-footer
desc: Animated wordmark footer with a camera-shutter letter: the brand runs edge to edge in a geometric SVG alphabet and one glyph is a three-blade shutter that turns to follow the pointer. Includes a newsletter field, social and legal links.

author: kedhareswer
name: silhouette-wrap
desc: Text wrap around shape cursor effect: a paragraph parts around a silhouette and closes back up underneath it. Canvas measureText and Intl.Segmenter set every line around an SVG shape or an image's own outline, reflowing as it chases your cursor. An interactive editorial background. React only.

author: kedhareswer
name: singularity-horizon
desc: 3D black hole hero background in raw WebGL2: a Doppler-shifted accretion disk around a singularity, rendered live behind your hero content. Use as a space-themed hero or section background. React is the only import, no three.js and no GSAP. Inspired by VoXelo's CodePen.

author: kedhareswer
name: slat-count-preloader
desc: Swiss poster counter preloader for React: black slats on vermilion slide sideways row by row to form the 0 to 100 count, never fading a glyph, then the poster splits into eight blinds that slide off left and right to reveal the page underneath. Gate mode over your content, a countdown mode, custom colours and labels, reduced-motion aware.

author: kedhareswer
name: smiley
desc: Interactive 3D emoji grid: smiley faces that respond to mouse movement with 3D transforms and morph from sad to happy on hover. A playful accent for hero sections, 404 pages or feedback prompts.

author: kedhareswer
name: snow-ball-loading-spinner
desc: Rolling snowball loading spinner: a textured snowball rolls around a soft, embossed circular track in a seamless loop. A calm, minimal loader for loading states, splash screens or winter-themed pages.

author: kedhareswer
name: staircase-carousel
desc: Staircase image carousel for React: the selected photo sits level at full size with its title, earlier photos step up and later ones step down, and the strip glides between steps on a spring with a blurred title swap. Dark stage, keyboard arrows and swipe, reduced-motion aware. Use for travel galleries, portfolios and editorial photo sets.

author: kedhareswer
name: starburst-thanks-footer
desc: Portfolio thank you footer: a closing 'thank you' slide with heavy caps, a hand-lettered marker line, a pen loop, a starburst and contact pills. Use it to end a portfolio, case study or deck.

author: kedhareswer
name: stardust-stage-preloader
desc: Dithered particle morph preloader in black-and-white stipple: a star with a progress orbit and counter fills, then every dot flies into a moonlit theatre stage with curtains and a wordmark before the page is revealed. Pointer parts the stardust. Use it as a cinematic loading screen. No dependencies.

author: kedhareswer
name: stepped-morph-slider
desc: Stepped morph image slider for React: each slide is revealed through a stepped skyline mask that morphs column by column into the next picture, with a story-style segmented timeline that fills as it autoplays, arrows, keyboard and swipe. Painted landscape demo, reduced-motion aware. Use as a hero slider or travel gallery.

author: kedhareswer
name: sunlit-cutting-mat
desc: Sunlight and leaf shadow shader background in WebGL: a green self-healing cutting mat with light falling through a blind and leaves, soft diagonal beams drifting across it. Use as a hero or section background for design and craft sites. Self-contained, no dependencies.

author: kedhareswer
name: ticket-stub-footer
desc: Animated SaaS footer section for React: a hairline grid with section index, CTA, spinning SVG globe and link columns over an interactive ticket with live status, a rolling odometer counter and a halftone canvas wordmark. Recolourable, zero dependencies.

author: kedhareswer
name: tiger-tear-reveal
desc: Scroll-driven paper tear hero reveal: a big slogan word cracks and rips in two, the torn halves pull apart and a tiger rises from behind, then its eyes follow the pointer and blink. All SVG from code, no images or dependencies; word, tagline and colours are props.

author: kedhareswer
name: tile-scrollbar
desc: Custom 3D tile scrollbar and scroll progress indicator: the page is cut into equal slices on a tilted tray, passed tiles press flat and darken, and the current one stands proud and fills. Click a tile to jump or drag to scrub. Zero dependencies, no Tailwind, every rule scoped inline.

author: kedhareswer
name: tilt-cascade-carousel
desc: Tilted card image carousel for React: square photos cascade down a slanted line, each card turning and shrinking away from the upright front card, and they swing into place one after another as you move. Looping autoplay, captions, dark stage, a glass prev/next pill with dots, keyboard, wheel and swipe, reduced-motion aware.

author: kedhareswer
name: velvet-haze
desc: Grainy light leak shader background in WebGL2: an out-of-focus silver and violet haze on black film grain, cut by soft shadows. The haze gathers under the pointer and a click sends a ripple through it. Full-screen, with your content layered on top. No three.js, no textures, React only.

author: kedhareswer
name: viewfinder-flip-carousel
desc: 3D flip image carousel for React: only the photo in the viewfinder frame lies flat while the rest fold away on their edges in perspective, opening out of the stack as you move, with a small frame pulse as each lands. Dark stage, titles, keyboard arrows and swipe, reduced-motion aware. Use for camera rolls, photo galleries and portfolios.

author: kedhareswer
name: water-ripple-carousel
desc: Water ripple image carousel for React: tap the photo and a WebGL ripple ring spreads from that point, bending the old photo at its edge as the next one appears inside it. Arrows, swipe, keyboard and autoplay, reduced-motion aware. Use as a hero slider or photo gallery.

author: kedhareswer
name: waving-portfolio-landing
desc: Animated portfolio landing page with a cinematic intro: a letter storm, a slot-reel headline, self-drawing details and an illustrated character who waves. Poster letters, name, roles and colours are all props. SVG only, no fonts, images or dependencies.

author: kedhareswer
name: zero-melt-preloader
desc: Ice melt gesture preloader and page gate with no enter button: a sheet of ice wipes down while a counter runs to zero, then you melt your way in by tracing a circle and the screen blows out to white and lifts. Raw WebGL2, two fullscreen passes, no three.js, React only.

author: kevingirelli
name: animated-border
desc: A card or container border with a glowing light that travels around its edge, used to draw attention to featured content.

author: kevingirelli
name: aurora
desc: A soft, slowly drifting multi-color light effect rendered behind content, used as a decorative background for hero sections or cards.

author: kevingirelli
name: bar-chart
desc: An accessible SVG bar chart for one data series that renders vertical or horizontal bars with a hover/focus tooltip and full keyboard navigation.

author: kevingirelli
name: contact-form
desc: A two-column contact section with a header and contact details on one side and a validated name/email/message form in a card on the other, with built-in pending, success and error states.

author: kevingirelli
name: corner-frame
desc: A decorative box that draws small bracket marks on its corners, like a camera viewfinder, used to frame cards, stats or images.

author: kevingirelli
name: dash-button
desc: A pill-shaped button that trades its solid fill for a marching dashed outline on hover and keyboard focus.

author: kevingirelli
name: faq
desc: A frequently-asked-questions section with a header and an accordion of questions and answers, in a split or stacked layout.

author: kevingirelli
name: flip-text
desc: A text component that flips each character or word into place around its horizontal axis with a 3D CSS rotation animation, playable on load or when scrolled into view.

author: kevingirelli
name: form
desc: A react-hook-form field wrapper that lays out a label, control, description and error with the id, aria-invalid and aria-describedby wiring already done for you.

author: kevingirelli
name: hover-reveal
desc: A content panel that reveals a second layer through a soft circle that follows the pointer, like a photo under a sketch or an answer hidden under a question.

author: kevingirelli
name: magnetic
desc: A wrapper that pulls its child content toward the cursor while hovered and springs it back on release, for magnetic buttons and links.

author: kevingirelli
name: marquee
desc: A content track that scrolls in a seamless infinite loop, pausing on hover or keyboard focus and off screen, and draggable by the pointer, for logo walls, tag lists or ticker-style content.

author: kevingirelli
name: newsletter
desc: An inline newsletter sign-up band with a title/description on one side and an email form with pending, success and error states on the other.

author: kevingirelli
name: not-found
desc: A 404 page section with a large decorative error code, a page heading, a description, and action buttons for finding your way back.

author: kevingirelli
name: pagination
desc: A page-number navigation with previous/next arrows and an ellipsis for long lists, plus a helper that works out which page numbers to show.

author: kevingirelli
name: pricing
desc: A pricing section with plan cards, a featured plan, and an optional monthly/yearly billing switch.

author: kevingirelli
name: qr-code
desc: A crisp SVG QR code component with dots, rounded or square module styles that renders fully on the server and can optionally animate itself into view.

author: kevingirelli
name: scramble-text
desc: A text component that decodes itself from random noise characters into the real words, settling left to right, for a terminal/hacker-style reveal.

author: kevingirelli
name: sheet
desc: A dialog panel that slides in from an edge of the screen, used for navigation menus, filters, and detail views.

author: kevingirelli
name: signature
desc: An SVG component that draws strokes as if by hand, like a signature, a wordmark outline or a route on a map, triggered on scroll-into-view, by scroll position, or by manual progress.

author: kevingirelli
name: spotlight
desc: A soft radial light that follows the pointer across a card or surface, with an optional lit edge ring, for highlighting hoverable panels.

author: kevingirelli
name: stepper
desc: An accessible multi-step progress indicator for flows like checkout or onboarding, showing which steps are complete, current, or upcoming, with optional clickable triggers.

author: kevingirelli
name: warp-gradient
desc: A slow, liquid field of blended colors driven by a single WebGL2 shader, used as a decorative animated background behind content.

author: kevingirelli
name: wave-text
desc: A text component that animates bands of colour washing through its characters like a swell, triggered on load or when scrolled into view.

author: kingm172009
desc: Animated WebGL shader background in the Mesh drift style. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. 4-color palette (#101010, #F5F5F5, #B0B0B0, #3A3A3A). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.

author: kingmckay13
name: ocean-perk
desc: Animated (flicker) ASCII art in the Dither style, made with the 21st ASCII editor and baked to a looping video. A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections, cards, and retro terminal-style backgrounds.

author: kokonutd
name: loader
desc: An animated full-screen loading indicator with a monochrome spinning ring and fading title/subtitle text, used while an app prepares or configures data for the user.

author: kokonutd
name: smooth-drawer
desc: An animated bottom drawer with spring-staggered content, a pricing block, and shimmer call-to-action button, ideal for upsell and paywall prompts.

author: kumail_ali_r
name: circle-unique-load
desc: A beautiful laoding component rotate regular and changes color and loading state text with diffrent symbols.

author: kumail_ali_r
name: core-header-navbar
desc: CoreHeader – A sleek top navigation bar for dashboards and apps. Displays the page title, user identity, and avatar, with a subtle background pattern for a modern look.

author: kuratlielia
name: activity-heatmap
desc: A GitHub-style contribution calendar that shows a year of daily activity as one tinted square per day, with hover/keyboard tooltips and a level legend.

author: kuratlielia
name: brush-chart
desc: A time-series chart with a zoomable overview strip beneath it—drag to draw a window, resize it by its handles, and read values and event markers in place.

author: kuratlielia
name: card-stack
desc: A draggable deck of cards reviewed one at a time, with swipe/throw gestures, buttons, keyboard shortcuts and undo — for quick triage like shortlisting destinations or candidates.

author: kuratlielia
name: combobox
desc: A searchable dropdown input that lets users filter and select one option from a list without leaving the text field.

author: kuratlielia
name: comment-thread
desc: A nested comment thread with reply threading, emoji reactions, inline edit/delete, @mention autocomplete, and a resolve/reopen toggle for review-style discussions.

author: kuratlielia
name: date-range-picker
desc: A date range input whose trigger button grows into a two-month calendar panel with presets, a stretching range highlight, and keyboard navigation, for reports, filters, and bookings.

author: kuratlielia
name: expandable-card
desc: A collapsible content card with a header trigger that smoothly morphs its width and height open to reveal more detail, built for dense dashboards or FAQ-style summaries.

author: kuratlielia
name: filter-toolbar
desc: An animated active-filter chip bar with remove/clear-all controls and an add-filter menu for stepping through fields and values, used to manage applied filters on a data table or collection view.

author: kuratlielia
name: hover-card
desc: A rich preview panel that opens over a mention, avatar, or link after a brief hover or keyboard focus, used to show a person's profile or linked content without leaving the page.

author: kuratlielia
name: image-compare
desc: A draggable before/after image slider that reveals a hidden image behind a moving divider, for comparing photo edits, redesigns, or visual changes.

author: kuratlielia
name: line-chart
desc: A multi-series line chart with a scrubbable crosshair, legend toggles to show/hide series, and lines that smoothly morph when the data range changes.

author: kuratlielia
name: multi-select
desc: A dropdown field that lets a user pick several values at once, showing them as removable chips with an overflow count.

author: kuratlielia
name: ridgeline
desc: A ridgeline (joy) plot that stacks overlapping smoothed distributions, one per group, so you can compare shapes like seasonal temperatures or response times at a glance; hover lifts a ridge to read its quartiles and switching datasets morphs every curve.

author: kuratlielia
name: segmented-control
desc: A horizontally scrollable group of mutually exclusive options with a gliding selection highlight, roving keyboard navigation, and an edge-fade for overflow content, used to switch between a small set of related views.

author: kuratlielia
name: signature-pad
desc: A touch and stylus signature field with pressure-sensitive variable-width ink, undo/redo, a clear animation, playback of the drawn signature, and PNG or SVG export.

author: kuratlielia
name: slider
desc: A draggable range/value slider input with a rolling-number value bubble, rubber-band drag resistance, marks, and keyboard support.

author: kuratlielia
name: slope-chart
desc: An animated chart that plots how a set of items changed between two time periods, connecting each item's two values with a line and showing rank movement beside each value.

author: kuratlielia
name: sortable-data-table

author: nikolas-sapa

author: nikolas-sapa

author: nikolas-sapa

author: vgpu
name: mnist-classifier
desc: Draw a digit and classify it with ONNX Runtime Web on WebGPU. Render the GPU-resident logits through a non-owning vgpu buffer wrap.

author: vgpu
name: nextjs-flare
desc: Next.js logo shader — a rim-lit N glyph with volumetric scattering: a 48-step ray walk jittered by blue noise over a separable Gaussian blur chain, breathing autonomously until the pointer takes over.

author: vgpu
name: optimized-black-hole
desc: A multi-pass black hole that bakes relativistic ray traversal once into a G-buffer, then reuses it for animated disk shading, stars, antialiasing and HDR bloom.

author: vgpu
name: particle-orbit
desc: A shared-device vgpu + TypeGPU experiment: TypeGPU advances light-seeking dust through a radiance field rendered by vgpu, then vgpu draws the same particle buffer zero-copy alongside orbiting lights, HDR bloom, and a CRT finish.

author: vgpu
name: radiance-cascades
desc: Draw light with the pointer and watch it bounce: a jump-flooded distance field feeds six radiance cascades — base 4, geometric intervals, linear RGBA16F — merged top-down with visibility alpha into 2D global illumination.

author: vgpu
name: raymarched-fractal
desc: A raymarched Sierpiński tetrahedron emerges from pure black under directional light and restrained HDR bloom, with drag-only orbit controls.

author: vgpu
name: three-tsl
desc: Author a procedural lava material as plain WGSL modules and wire them into a three.js node material — twelve surface slots, all driven from shader source.

author: vgpu
name: transmission
desc: A glass cube refracts the scene behind it in screen space: the frame is rendered, blurred into a pyramid, and read back through Snell refraction, chromatic dispersion and a Fresnel-weighted environment reflection.

author: vgpu
name: triangle-led-front
desc: Analytic edge-glow triangle with LED emitters, floor radiance, and interactive color deploy. Canvas-scoped pointer input drives the lighting while a lil-gui selector chooses highlighted edges.

author: vgpu
name: tsl-exports
desc: Turn one exported WGSL function into a callable Three.js TSL node and use it on a physical material.

author: vijayksingh
name: meter
desc: A horizontal row of LED-style segments showing a level within a range (storage, battery, signal), colored green/amber/red by position with a sweeping lamp-by-lamp animation when the value changes.

author: vijayksingh
name: skeleton
desc: A placeholder loading state made of blocks, text lines, and circles that stands in for content while it loads, then fades into the real content once it arrives.

author: vijayksingh
name: spinner
desc: A small loading indicator with a sunk circular well and a turning green arc, used inside or beside a control (like a Save button) while it's working, that waits briefly before appearing so quick actions never flash it.

author: vijayksingh
name: textarea
desc: An auto-growing multi-line text input with a character counter that fades in near the limit and shakes if the user types past it.

author: vijayksingh
name: weather
desc: A weather card that draws the sky as an animated dot-matrix scene following the time of day (sun arc, moon phase, clouds, rain, snow, wind), with the current temperature, an hourly forecast strip and a 7-day low/high range chart, plus a compact single-condition tile variant.

author: wensity

author: wensity

author: wensity

author: wensity
